description: Source code for TrustStoreAndroid class implementation, managing trust store initialization, certificate parsing, and trust management within the Chromium project.

classes.name: TrustStoreAndroid::Impl
classes.description: Implementation class managing the in-memory trust store, certificate parsing, and trust retrieval, with reference counting for thread safety.

methods.name: TrustStoreAndroid::~TrustStoreAndroid
methods.description: Destructor for TrustStoreAndroid, removes certificate database observer if observing.

methods.name: TrustStoreAndroid::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the trust store, possibly creating the implementation instance.

methods.name: TrustStoreAndroid::ObserveCertDBChanges
methods.description: Registers as an observer for certificate database changes.

methods.name: TrustStoreAndroid::OnCertDBChanged
methods.description: Handles certificate database change notifications, updating the trust store generation.

methods.name: TrustStoreAndroid::MaybeInitializeAndGetImpl
methods.description: Returns the current implementation instance, creating or updating it if needed based on generation.

methods.name: TrustStoreAndroid::SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate.

methods.name: TrustStoreAndroid::GetTrust
methods.description: Retrieves trust information for a given certificate.
